zh: 彌迦斥責以色列的領袖

p.src: 1  I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

たちよ、聞け。 あなたがたは
en: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
u.src: 1  I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

p.src: 2  You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

ja: している。 私の民の
en: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

p.src: 3  who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

ja: れる肉のように、 大
en: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.
u.src: 3  who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

p.src: 4  Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

en: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

p.src: 5  The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

ja: の間に食べ物を入れてくれる者には「
en: The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:
u.src: 5  The LORD says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

zh: 3:5 預備攻擊他：或譯說必遭遇刀兵

p.src: 6  “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

ja: 「それゆえ、あなたがたを幻のない
うことのできない闇が覆う。
en: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
u.src: 6  “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

p.src: 7  The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

en: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”
u.src: 7  The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

ja: 3:7 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。

p.src: 8  But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

ja: たされている。 ヤコブにその
きを、 イスラエルにその
en: But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
u.src: 8  But as for me, I am full of power by the LORD’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

p.src: 9  Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

ja: のかしらたちよ、 イスラエルの
の支配者たちよ、これを
を忌み嫌い、 すべての
en: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,
u.src: 9  Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

p.src: 10  who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

ja: を流してシオンを築き、
によってエルサレムを建てる。
en: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
u.src: 10  who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

p.src: 11  Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”

ja: におられるではないか。
en: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
u.src: 11  Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on the LORD, and say, “Isn’t the LORD among us? No disaster will come on us.”
